author: mehmetxs34
quote: Unlike other Far Cry games, this game is definitely much better. The fact that we don't have another story-driven Stone Age game, and that it's even better with different races and languages, is great. The taming is engaging, and they've managed to convey a feeling of difficulty and unease at that age. The boss fights aren't bad at all, and the combat mechanics are good, even well-designed despite the old-world machinery. However, during the side quests, The hallucination tasks, in particular, are extremely bad, like they were designed by a 10-year-old, and the whole moving and carrying things around is boring and awful.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: Well, it's a boring Hollywood superhero story, a disgusting villain, it starts off great but then becomes completely mediocre, but even so, it's not that bad. A classic Spider-Man game, fun to explore the city, helping people is a nice feature, the combat mechanics are not bad at all, in fact, they're pretty good.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: Absolute cinema. If someone ever asks whether games can be considered true works of art, show them this—it is the ultimate answer. It features some of the best music and art design you could ever encounter in a game. It stands as proof of what can be created when people who are truly passionate about their craft make a game. I intend to keep singing this game’s praises until the next one comes along.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: Fantastic, just fantastic—what else can I say? I never imagined I’d enjoy this game so much. The animations are superb, and the variety of bosses is incredible—this game features more bosses than any other I’ve seen, and none of them are repetitive. There’s an exceptionally diverse skill tree and an endless array of features; they’ve also captured Chinese history perfectly—the game is truly a work of art. The music pulls you right into the atmosphere, and the graphics are outstanding—I felt like I was caught in the middle of an absolute storm of action.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: Amazing, amazing, perfect, what can I say about this game? In a word, it's one of the best of all time. Fantastic combat mechanics, amazing animations, a great story, and a pace that never slows down. What a game!The answer to your question is this game.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: It's definitely not a bad game, quite the opposite, it's a good game. Unlike other games, it doesn't limit you to RPG elements; the setting and Baghdad are beautiful, and considering we have no visuals of the city, the effort put into it is incredible. The cult events and the The story isn't spectacular, but it's not bad either; being an assassin offers various possibilities.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: I could write a book about this game, but my words wouldn't suffice. This game is a production that deserves to be made into a film, simply because it's a game. The music, the atmosphere, the graphics, the story, the characters, the main character Arthur Morgan Open world events...

author: mehmetxs34
quote: Bad, simply terrible, depressing, boring characters, disgusting facial models, a repulsive, boring, soulless main character and supporting characters, a meaningless, trashy story.

author: mehmetxs34
quote: This is the worst game I've ever played; I'm even ashamed to call it a game. It doesn't deserve a single point. All the side stories are the same, the side characters constantly repeat the same "find my husband and rescue him from the same place 15 times" type of scenario. The main character, Bayek, is completely soulless, no different from the other NPCs. The NPCs are equally soulless; like statues standing in the same spot, they give us meaningless, repetitive quests. Only the open world was satisfying.
